title: BookPackaging
description: The AUTHORED book packaging (规范 §3): 书名 / 一句话卖点 / 简介 / 标签, plus the explicit PROMISES the packaging makes to a reader who clicks. Packaging is the front of the commercial funnel (点击 × 前三章留存 × …): it decides whether a reader opens the book at all, and its promises decide whether the first three chapters feel honored or bait. It is an AUTHORED source (like novel-brain), not a fact (ADR-006) and not a projection (ADR-008); it lives at sources/book-packaging.yaml. Promises are DECLARED by the author rather than inferred from blurb prose, so the delivery check that reads them is deterministic and does not pretend to understand semantics.

gating.description: Structural invariant (ADR-003): packaging and its promise-delivery check are EVALUATIVE. A packaging inconsistency never blocks a build or a chapter. It is a signal for a human editor.

authority.description: Structural invariant (ADR-009): the title/blurb/tags a book ships under is an outward, hard-to-reverse commitment to readers and to the platform. The system may DRAFT and CHECK packaging; only a human authorizes what actually ships.

title.description: 书名. §3.1: it must do at least one job — mark the genre, hint the core mechanism, present the identity/conflict, create suspense, or set the emotional register.

one_line_pitch.description: 一句话卖点 (§2.1). Recommended shape: 成熟大类 + 核心机制 + 主角身份 + 持续矛盾 + 差异化情绪. '主角拥有系统' is NOT a complete pitch — it must say what the protagonist opposes and what using the ability costs.

blurb.description: 简介 (§3.2). Should carry: 主角当前处境 / 最大异常或核心机制 / 主角立即要做什么 / 最大阻力 / 读者将获得的体验 / 一个尚未回答的具体问题. It must NOT read as a world encyclopedia.

tags.description: 平台标签. Must point at the same reading experience as the title, blurb, and the first three chapters.

promises.description: What the packaging COMMITS to deliver, and by when (§3.3 承诺一致性). Each entry is checkable: the author names the concrete terms whose presence in the draft evidences delivery, so the check is deterministic and never guesses at meaning.

promise_type.description: The kind of promise, e.g. 金手指 / 复仇 / 经营 / 规则怪谈 / 智斗 / 身份逆转 / 建立势力 / 收集. Free text: the taxonomy differs by genre and the check keys on evidence_terms, not on this label.

statement.description: What the reader is promised, in the reader's own terms.

must_appear_by.description: The chapter by which this promise must be visibly honored. Defaults to 3 — the 黄金三章 window, where §3.3 requires every packaging promise to be cashed at least once.

evidence_terms.description: Concrete terms (mechanism names, entity names, actions) whose presence in the draft body evidences that this promise is being delivered. AUTHORED on purpose: a book's promise lives in its own vocabulary, so a stock term list would misjudge it.

provenance.description: Optional authoring provenance (who/what drafted this packaging, and from which outline).
